positions.position: Interested in booking with advance payments on the site
Does not want payments on the site, too complicated

conflicts.resolution: Meena rejected payments and Lakshmi agreed to defer it, deciding no online payments for version one and using WhatsApp instead.

dimensions.justification: Goals are to promote tourism and increase customers. Success is measured by website visitors, WhatsApp enquiries, and conversion to bookings/orders.
Target audience is tourists from Hyderabad and Bangalore. Mobile-first approach is specified.
Needs for homestay (Lakshmi), restaurant (Ravi), and boat tours (Meena) are clearly attributed.
Single-page website structure with sections for each business is defined.
Features include WhatsApp buttons, menu display, map directions, and photo galleries.
Acceptance criteria provided for WhatsApp buttons, homestay, and restaurant sections. Boat tour section lacks specific G/W/T criteria.
Each owner is responsible for their own content. Lakshmi coordinates collection.
Calm natural look requested. Photos are to be supplied by owners.
Mobile-friendly is specified. No specific requirements for load time, SEO, or accessibility.
Budget ($400), deadline (next month), and maintenance plan (Lakshmi as contact) are defined.

acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor clicks the WhatsApp button, When the chat opens, Then it opens a WhatsApp chat with the relevant business phone number and a pre-filled greeting message.
requirements.description: A button on the website to initiate a WhatsApp conversation with the business owners with pre-filled greeting.
requirements.title: WhatsApp Contact Button

requirements.description: Website content in English and Telugu.
requirements.title: Multilingual Support

acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor views the homestay section, When they check available rooms, Then they can view room photos, descriptions, basic amenities, and a WhatsApp button.
requirements.description: Display rooms and contact information for Sea Breeze Homestay.
requirements.title: Homestay Section

acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor views the restaurant section, When they check the menu and location, Then the menu, opening hours, and a map directions link are clearly displayed.
requirements.description: Display menu, timings, and directions for Ravi's Fish Kitchen.
requirements.title: Restaurant Section
